fix_consequences: adding tools to request_body alone makes arms worse: with a schema the reply's content is empty (probe content_len=0) and run_longrun.py:2426 feeds resp['content'] to parse_tool_calls, which finds nothing
client.py:766 already flattens the call to tool_calls_present:true, discarding the arguments one layer below the consumer
the fix is two coupled changes: carry tools in request_body gated on tools_enabled(cfg), and consume message.tool_calls instead of scanning content
request_digest (client.py:305) covers exact bytes, so a tools-on body changes every request sha; row/ledger identity that assumed the old body must be told
tools_mode (client.py:862) already labels a tools-on run 'on:read_file' although the wire never carried a schema, so existing tools-on rows misreport their provenance
